messages:
marie_sales: Hey team — Greenfield Capital sent an RFP and wants a fed‑gov style capability matrix + POC timeline. They also threw in a security questionnaire. Can we get a short plan and owners by EOD?

ajay_se: I skimmed the RFP. POC ask = 2‑week eval, 3 infra scenarios (hosted, dedicated, VPC). They want perf numbers for 4k token average prompt and embedding throughput.

luis_eng: For hosted perf we can provide 99th latency and tokens/sec from the last benchmark. For Dedicated we need to reserve capacity; timeline + ETA depends on GPU availability.

dana_security: I pulled the sec questionnaire — asks for SOC2, encryption in transit+at rest, KMS/HSM, customer key rollover, VPC peering, and audit logs retention. We have most items; will need to provide the SOC2 cert PDF and a short explanation for key management.

marie_sales: Good. Attachments: I uploaded the draft capability matrix to the sales drive: https://drive.redwood/internal/sales/rfps/greenfield-cap-matrix-v1.xlsx (note: internal link). Can someone update tech columns and fill 'POC acceptance criteria'?

ajay_se: I'll update model support, streaming, function-calls, and autotuning rows. For POC acceptance criteria propose: "1) 95th latency < 350ms for 512 tokens; 2) embeddings throughput >= 200/sec; 3) end‑to‑end logs + 14d retention". Thoughts?

dana_security: Add: "keys managed via customer KMS (bring-your-own-key) or Redwood-managed with rotation policy; audit export to S3. Provide sample IAM policy." I can draft a one‑pager and attach SOC2.

luis_eng: For Dedicated POC we should propose a 'mini-reserved' with 1xA100 equiv for 2 weeks. Ops impacts: provisioning ~5 business days after contract. Sam_ops, can you confirm capacity?

sam_ops: Confirmed — we have a spare node window next week (1768800000ish) but need signed MSA + payment terms to lock. Also note: dedicated GPUs will require a simple infra templated runbook; I can produce it this afternoon.

marie_sales: Perfect. Who owns pricing? Greenfield asked about an upfront POC discount and a follow‑on reserved discount. We should propose: POC = 50% off hosted list for 2 weeks; reserved commit = 15% for 6mo. Agree?

ajay_se: 50% POC seems fine if we cap usage and include an out clause. For the reserved commit, need to check with finance but 15% inline with prior deals.

dana_security: Quick Q: do we have a short answer for data residency? Greenfield requires EU region only for PII.

luis_eng: Hosted + Dedicated can be pinned to eu‑west region. Private (on‑prem) is also an option. Add that to matrix under 'data residency'.

marie_sales: Action items: ajay — update matrix + POC acceptance criteria and paste CSV snippet in thread. dana — SOC2 PDF + KMS one‑pager. sam_ops — templated runbook + capacity confirmation. luis — confirm provisioning ETA and region mapping. I'll draft pricing terms and a short cover email. Deadline: EOD today, we send first pass to legal for review by 09:00 tomorrow.

ajay_se: CSV snippet for matrix (will update full sheet):

```
feature,hosted,dedicated,private
model-support,curated-open + redwood-verified,curated-open + pinned-versions,customer-private
streaming,yes,yes,yes
data-residency,eu/us/east,eu/us/east,customer-network
poc-acceptance,"95th <350ms; embeddings >=200/s; logs 14d",same,same
```

sam_ops: Runbook link once ready: https://runbooks.redwood/internal/poc/dedicated-poc-template.md (will attach) :thumbsup:

marie_sales: Thanks everyone — if we can close this loop by EOD I’ll send the RFP response + matrix to the buyer and copy legal. Ping me if you need any handoffs. :pray:

deploy-bot: Document uploaded: greenfield-soc2.pdf -> /assets/security/greenfield-soc2.pdf

luis_eng: One last note — Flagging potential blocker: customer asked for custom quantization profile which may require additional ML engineer hours (estimate 2–3 days). I'm logging it as a billable POC addendum.

marie_sales: Noted. I'll include as optional line item in pricing. Sending reminder in 1h to check progress.
